caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a matching lid, both predominately colored in shades of reddish-orange with lighter wavy decorative patterns. The lid features concentric circular bands of green and gold-yellow, with a small, rounded gold knob at the center. Similar green-and-yellow ornamental bands encircle the top and bottom edges of the container, as well as one band around its midsection. Below the main object, there is a detailed depiction of a segment of the lid, showing the same color patterns and ornamental designs, including the knob, viewed from a different angle. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color with a subtle rectangular area behind the objects, possibly to highlight them. The name “C.W. Brown” is written beneath the lid segment illustration.
title: Pa. German Sugar Tub
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
